prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1426; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Our client has suffered physical injuries as a result of the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment, and we intend to pursue full compensation for those losses.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm whether any other policies may apply to this loss.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, repair estimates, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any claim correspondence. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending.
